sentences.text: Researchers analyzed gene activity and histone modifications in numerous individual cells from the adult human brain using two separate atlases. This approach revealed that distinct brain cell types exhibit unique patterns of gene regulation.

The data indicated that epigenetic marks established during earlier development persist within these adult cells, offering insights into how genetic changes associated with neurological disorders impact specific cell populations.
The authors conclude that these results establish a new framework for investigating how brain cells are defined, how they evolve, and how diseases originate.
